title: Evaluation case
description: The structural contract for one evaluation case, and the one validate_dataset.py enforces.

criticality.description: critical means one failure on this case is not a matter of degree.

annotation_status.description: Where the expected output came from, and whether it may be used. `approved` means a qualified human judged what the right answer is and the judgement was reviewed. `derived` means the expected output follows from a specification — a formula, a schema, an entitlement rule — so there was nothing to judge; it is the correct status for a DoD case, which needs no annotated reference. `draft` and `reviewed` are stages on the way to `approved`, and neither is eligible for a run.
